body.hypothesis: Out-of-time holdout: XNAS ITCH 2026-05-15 and 2026-05-18 (AAPL, MSFT, QQQ), never used for design or fitting; params, horizon, universe, cost model frozen as of the v1.7.2 tree. Fit/evidence base: 7 sessions 2019-01-30..2020-01-30. Confirmed iff leakage passes, gate IC has the registered sign and gate t >= the run's Bonferroni threshold (fresh ledger on the holdout dataset). Positive sign with t below threshold = 'weaker, not confirmed'. Statistical only; no P&L claim. PRIMARY. Microprice deviation predicts the 1s mid move (in-sample gate IC 0.105, t 21.1).

Out-of-time holdout: XNAS ITCH 2026-05-15 and 2026-05-18 (AAPL, MSFT, QQQ), never used for design or fitting; params, horizon, universe, cost model frozen as of the v1.7.2 tree. Fit/evidence base: 7 sessions 2019-01-30..2020-01-30. Confirmed iff leakage passes, gate IC has the registered sign and gate t >= the run's Bonferroni threshold (fresh ledger on the holdout dataset). Positive sign with t below threshold = 'weaker, not confirmed'. Statistical only; no P&L claim. CONTROL, expected to fail. Short-horizon reversal at 10s with the rationale's positive sign; in-sample the fitted sign contradicted it (IC -0.012, t -3.0). A negative IC again is evidence the rationale is wrong.

Out-of-time holdout: XNAS ITCH 2026-05-15 and 2026-05-18 (AAPL, MSFT, QQQ), never used for design or fitting; params, horizon, universe, cost model frozen as of the v1.7.2 tree. Fit/evidence base: 7 sessions 2019-01-30..2020-01-30. Confirmed iff leakage passes, gate IC has the registered sign and gate t >= the run's Bonferroni threshold (fresh ledger on the holdout dataset). Positive sign with t below threshold = 'weaker, not confirmed'. Statistical only; no P&L claim. CONTROL, expected underpowered. Trade-flow at 5s; in-sample t 3.6 failed the gate; power-real needs IC ~0.02 on 7 sessions, so a miss on 2 sessions is 'cannot tell'.
